text: The Malaysian government banned Bobby S. Sayyid's A Fundamental Fear: Eurocentrism and the Emergence of Islamism in 2006. The Ministry of Home Affairs gazetted the ban on 8 June 2006 under the Printing Presses and Publications Act, and a second record dates a ban to 2007. Sayyid said the ban was based on British colonial legislation allowing the proscription of publications deemed prejudicial to public morality.
meta_description: A Fundamental Fear by Bobby S. Sayyid: banned in Malaysia in 2006 under the Printing Presses and Publications Act, according to the Ministry of Home Affairs.
changes: Added ministry, gazette date and Act from the ban row; author's claim kept as his; chronological order.
